units.fresh-pairs: 24 already revealed independent demand seeds; supplemental validation, not blinded confirmation
units.historical-A: 24 historical demand seeds; DRILL observation replay against historical ECMP
units.historical-B: 24 separate historical demand seeds; never pooled with other cohorts
units.sustained-pilot: 2 independent demand seeds; timing conditions and 8 rounds are repeated measures

estimand: Within-demand 100*(candidate/reference-1); demand median; never ratio of pooled means or pooled flow inference

bootstrap.unit: demand seed, identical resampling indexes for both endpoints and all contrasts within cohort
bootstrap.interpretation: Nominal unadjusted percentile intervals; no p-values, significance stars or automatic pass/fail

topk_selection: ECMP FCT-ranked fixed message identities within each demand/round; deterministic identity tie-break; all max ties retained separately in batch-tail metadata
missing_policy: Record every expected cell and pair; no zero filling, timeout substitution, completion-only ranking or complete-case inferential summaries
required_figures: per-demand distributions of identity-paired flow changes
qualifications: Sustained results await both ConWeave off/on FCT pairs; historical recovery/performance join awaits all 48 historical DRILL FCT hashes matching originals
